AI & Data / LinkedIn post

AI in cross-border payments: the operational opportunity.

A look back at my August 2025 article on decision support in payments.

Brajkishor Pandey

Engineering leader · Fintech architect · Originally published 2025-08-09

Adapted from my LinkedIn writing and related technical material. Read original on LinkedIn ↗

My August 2025 LinkedIn article discussed AI across fraud detection, route selection, compliance workflows, and FX-related planning.

For an engineering team, the useful question is where better information can improve a defined decision. The surrounding payment system still needs a clear transaction model, authoritative controls, traceable provider outcomes, and financial reconciliation.

Evaluate any proposed automation against the actual corridor, data quality, operating policy, and measurable outcome. Claims from an earlier deployment should not be treated as a guarantee for another platform.

The source link preserves the original article and its historical context. This page presents a shorter engineering-focused adaptation.
